rows.name: 基什
rows.enIdentity: Capital of the Sumerian city-state of Kish
rows.years: 约前3千纪，不采用王表神话君主的精确年代
rows.note: 基什由乌海米尔、因加拉等多个遗址丘组成。早王朝城邦与后世神庙分期表达；原始OSM的castle_wall只是数十米建筑墙段，身份不足，不作为全城墙接入。完整分期城界待核。
rows.enNote: Kish comprises several mounds including Uhaimir and Ingharra. The dated city-state is distinguished from later temples. Unidentified short OSM castle_wall traces are excluded rather than promoted to a city circuit.

features.name: 乌海米尔遗址丘（基什西部）
因加拉遗址丘（基什东部）

rows.name: 伊辛
rows.enIdentity: Capital of the First Dynasty of Isin
rows.note: 慕尼黑大学确认其为公元前2千纪初独立王都。古拉神庙圣区围墙不等于全城墙；东南部建筑仅被提出可能为宫殿，不作确定王宫。伊辛第二王朝名称不等于全期都城位于伊辛。完整分期城界待核。
rows.enNote: LMU identifies an independent capital in the early second millennium BCE. The Gula temple enclosure is not the city wall; a proposed southeastern palace remains uncertain. The later dynastic name does not establish continuous residence at Isin.

rows.name: 拉尔萨
rows.enIdentity: Capital of the kingdom of Larsa
rows.years: 约前2025—前1763（采用中年表，早期独立阶段有讨论）
rows.note: 法国文化部确认都城身份；CNRS团队已识别约5376米城防走向。已有城墙研究不等于已取得可直接上图的测绘矢量。努尔阿达德宫未完全发掘，部分入口与外立面不明。完整城墙图件配准待核。
rows.enNote: The French Ministry of Culture identifies a capital; CNRS reports a 5,376 m wall trace. This research does not supply an immediately usable surveyed vector. Nur-Adad palace is incompletely excavated, with entrances and facades still unknown.

features.name: 拉尔萨遗址区（非城墙界）

rows.name: 埃什努纳
rows.enIdentity: Capital of the independent kingdom of Eshnunna
rows.years: 约前20—前18世纪（独立王国阶段）
rows.note: 芝加哥大学发掘报告明确区分乌尔第三王朝属城与后来独立公国都城。统治者宫殿及舒辛神庙为不同建筑；未取得可靠轮廓前不绘制随意宫城。完整分期城界待核。
rows.enNote: The excavation report distinguishes provincial Eshnunna under Ur III from the later independent capital. The Rulers Palace and Shu-Sin temple are separate buildings; neither a palace circuit nor a city wall is invented.

features.name: 埃什努纳遗址区（泰勒阿斯马尔）

rows.name: 拉格什
rows.identity: 苏美尔拉格什城邦政治中心
rows.enIdentity: Political capital of the Sumerian state of Lagash
rows.years: 约前3千纪中叶（早王朝时期）
rows.note: 拉格什政体包含拉格什、吉尔苏及尼纳等城址，此根点仅为Tell al-Hiba。宾夕法尼亚大学已发掘神庙及行政建筑；不把政体疆域当成此城城界，亦不将其与吉尔苏合并。完整分期城界待核。
rows.enNote: The state of Lagash comprised distinct cities. This root is Tell al-Hiba only, separate from Girsu; the polity territory is not a city boundary. Penn excavations identify temples and administrative buildings.

rows.name: 吉尔苏
rows.identity: 拉格什王国王廷与政治中心
rows.enIdentity: Royal and political capital of the state of Lagash
rows.regime: 拉格什王国吉尔苏王廷
rows.years: 约前3千纪中后期（含古地亚时期；不假定连续迁都年表）
rows.note: 与Tell al-Hiba分址。大英博物馆确认王宫、宁吉尔苏神庙等遗存；不能把所有“宫殿丘”旧解均当成确定宫殿，现代保护范围不作为全城墙。完整分期城界待核。
rows.enNote: Separate from Tell al-Hiba. British Museum research identifies royal and sacred remains; older interpretations of the Mound of the Palace are not all adopted as established palaces. Modern site limits do not establish the ancient city wall.

rows.name: 杜尔库里加尔祖
rows.identity: 巴比伦加喜特王朝王都
rows.years: 约前14—前12世纪（建城后王都阶段）
rows.note: UNESCO预备名单资料明确其为王都，有塔庙、王宫及宗教建筑。塔庙台基不等于王宫或完整城郭；预备名单不是正式世界遗产，不新增虚假的世界遗产合并身份。完整城墙与王宫围界待核。
rows.enNote: The UNESCO Tentative List identifies the Kassite royal capital with ziggurat, palaces and temples. A ziggurat footprint is not a palace or city circuit; tentative listing is not World Heritage inscription.

features.name: 杜尔库里加尔祖塔庙（现存及修复）

rows.name: 底格里斯河畔塞琉西亚
rows.identity: 塞琉古王朝早期都城与东方王廷
rows.enIdentity: Early Seleucid capital and eastern royal centre
rows.years: 约前4世纪末—前3世纪（早期及东方王廷阶段）
rows.note: 与邻近泰西封及萨珊新城韦赫阿尔达希尔分址。都城地位不延伸为整个帕提亚时期；档案馆、广场和住宅区不能混称王宫。原始OSM保护区边界不作为历史城墙。完整分期城界待核。
rows.enNote: Distinct from Ctesiphon and Veh Ardashir. Royal-capital status is not extended to the entire Parthian period. Archives and residential remains are not palaces; modern protected-area limits are not ancient walls.

features.name: 塞琉西亚遗址区（非全城墙界）

rows.name: 马里
rows.enIdentity: Capital of the city-state and kingdom of Mari
rows.years: 约前3千纪中叶—前18世纪（含中断与重建阶段）
rows.note: 法国文化部确认其为两河流域都城。外堤、内城防与王宫圣区不同，不能依据约2.9千米直径画一个圆代替城墙。王宫遗迹与城址标绘分开；完整双重城防矢量待核。
rows.enNote: The official French mission identifies Mari as a Mesopotamian capital. Outer flood defences, inner city fortifications and the sacred palace enclosure are distinct; no circular boundary is invented from a published diameter.

rows.name: 库法
rows.identity: 正统哈里发阿里时期都城
rows.enIdentity: Capital under the Rashidun caliph Ali
rows.note: 建城、驻军城与656—661年都城阶段分开。现存大清真寺含后世修建；总督宫遗址不等于整个城市，后来的地区首府身份不延长为国家都城。完整早期城界待核。
rows.enNote: The foundation as a garrison town is separate from its capital phase in 656–661. The mosque includes later rebuilding; the governor palace is not the whole city. Later administrative roles are not treated as a continuous national capital.
